grp_def_sql: select min(a.strt_date) begin_date, max(a.end_date) end_date, a.rela_inr_org_id grp_val, max(concat(b.inr_org_name,'(企业客群_回购账户)')) grp_name from (select * from pdata_n.T04_INR_ORG_RELA_H where inr_org_rela_type_cd = '11' and end_date = '2099-12-31') a join (select * from pdata_n.T04_INR_ORG where inr_org_cate_cd = '2' and del_flag='0' and inr_org_type_cd in ('205')) b on a.inr_org_id = b.inr_org_id group by a.rela_inr_org_id

grp_type_name: 总部各部门(企业客群_回购账户)
grp_def_sql: select min(case when length(trim(setp_date)) < 10 or setp_date is null then '1900-01-01' else setp_date end) begin_date, max(case when length(trim(canc_date)) < 10 or canc_date is null then '2099-12-31' else canc_date end) end_date, inr_org_id grp_val,max(concat(inr_org_shor_name,'(企业客群_回购账户)')) grp_name from pdata_n.t98_org_inr_org_base_info where busi_date = ':data_day_str' and inr_org_type_cd='203' group by inr_org_id
select '1900-01-01' begin_date, '2099-12-31' end_date, user_id grp_val, '' grp_name from PDATA_N.T98_USER_ID_INFO where busi_date = ':data_day_str'

select min(a.strt_date) begin_date, max(a.end_date) end_date, a.rela_inr_org_id grp_val, max(concat(b.inr_org_name, '(企业客群)')) grp_name from (select * from pdata_n.T04_INR_ORG_RELA_H where inr_org_rela_type_cd = '11' and end_date = '2099-12-31') a join (select * from pdata_n.T04_INR_ORG where inr_org_cate_cd = '2' and del_flag = '0' and inr_org_type_cd in ('220','22001','22002','20701','20702','20703')) b on a.inr_org_id = b.inr_org_id group by a.rela_inr_org_id

select min(case when length(trim(setp_date)) < 8 or setp_date is null then '1900-01-01' else default.datekey2date(setp_date) end) begin_date, max(case when length(trim(canc_date)) < 8 or canc_date is null then '2099-12-31' else default.datekey2date(canc_date) end) end_date, inr_org_id grp_val, '广发证券' grp_name from pdata_n.t98_org_inr_org_base_info where busi_date = default.pretradedate(date_add(':data_day_str',1),1) and inr_org_shor_name='广发证券' group by inr_org_id
